intro: How to report what someone said or asked: «dijo que», «preguntó si», «preguntó dónde».
p.dijo que.consejo: After «que» you report what was said: «dijo que estaba cansada». No quotation marks.
p.me dijo.consejo: «Me» is who was told: «me dijo que sí», «te dijo que no», «le dijo que vale».
p.preguntó si.consejo: For yes/no questions. «Si» has no accent: «me preguntó si hablaba español».
p.preguntó dónde.consejo: It keeps the accent of «dónde», but no question marks: «preguntó dónde vivía».
p.contestó.consejo: It is the opposite of «preguntó». You can also say «respondió»: «contestó que sí».
p.explicó.consejo: The stress is on the last syllable: eks-pli-KO. «Que» can follow: «explicó que…».
p.estaba.consejo: It is the imperfect of «estar». When reporting, «está» usually becomes «estaba».
p.vivía.consejo: The accent is on the i: bi-BI-a. The imperfect of -er and -ir verbs ends in -ía.
p.cansada.consejo: It changes with the person: «cansada» if it is she, «cansado» if it is he.
p.si.consejo: Without an accent it is «si» (if, whether). With an accent, «sí», it means «yes».
p.sí.consejo: With an accent it is «yes»: «me dijo que sí». Without it, «si» is another word.
b1.texto:
To report what someone said you use **dijo que**. If it was a yes/no question: **preguntó si**. If it had a question word, you keep it without question marks: **¿Dónde vives?** → Me preguntó **dónde vivía**.

When the reporting verb is in the past, the present usually moves to the **imperfect**:

- «Estoy cansada» → Ana dijo que **estaba** cansada.
- «¿Hablas español?» → Me preguntó si **hablaba** español.

But if it is still true now, you can keep the present: Ana dijo que **está** mejor.
b2.f0.texto: What did Ana tell you yesterday?
b2.f1.texto: She told me she was very tired.
b2.f2.texto: And did she ask you whether you spoke Spanish?
b2.f3.texto: She also asked me where I lived.
b2.f5.texto: I answered that I worked near here.
b2.f6.texto: Ana explained to me that the office was closed.
b2.f7.texto: Now Ana says she is already better.
b3.titulo: Words for reporting what was said
b4.texto:
1. Choose the verb: **dijo que** (statements), **preguntó si** (yes/no) or **preguntó + question word** (dónde, cuándo, qué…).
2. Drop the question marks. For yes/no questions use **si** with no accent.
3. Change the persons and the tense: «**Vivo** aquí» → Dijo que **vivía** allí.

**Contestó**, **explicó** or **contó** work the same way: Explicó que **trabajaba** de noche.
b4.e1.texto: She asked me whether I spoke Spanish.
b4.e2.texto: Pablo answered that he lived near the market.
b5.f0.texto: The station smells of wet iron and freshly made coffee.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía waits beside a column with her hands in her pockets.
b5.f2.texto: A loudspeaker announces that the six o'clock train is arriving a little late.
b5.f3.texto: An elderly woman asks her whether that platform is the one for the northern trains.
b5.f4.texto: Lucía answers her with a smile and points to the big clock at the back.
b5.f5.texto: Later, in the carriage, Pablo tells her what Ana said to him on the phone.
b5.f6.texto: Ana said the landscape was green and golden, and that the train sang over the bridges.
b5.f7.texto: Through the window pass fields of wheat, red roofs and calm horses.
b5.f8.texto: Lucía rests her forehead on the glass and remembers every word of the call.
b5.f9.texto: Outside, the sun sinks slowly and paints the distant clouds orange.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! Yes/no questions are reported with «si».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Qué» asks about a thing; here the question is yes or no.
b6.pregunta: It was a yes/no question. What is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it! She said it yesterday, so the present moves to the imperfect.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Estoy» is Ana's person, not mine: it has to change.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The future changes the meaning: she was talking about that moment.
b7.pregunta: Ana said yesterday «Estoy cansada». How do you report it?
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done! The question word stays, with its accent.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Without the accent it does not ask: «donde» only points to a place.
b9.pregunta: It was a question with a question word. What is missing?
b10.o2.refuerzo: That is it! The accent marks the affirmative answer.
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «She asked me if I spoke Spanish».
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes! If the information is still current, the present can stay.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is not a mistake: it is possible when what was said is still true.
b12.o2: Siempre hay que usar el presente.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Not always: the usual thing is to move to the imperfect when it is past.
b12.pregunta: «Ana dijo que está mejor». Why does «está» stay?
p.hablabas.consejo: Imperfect of «hablar», for «tú». The «b» is soft between vowels.
p.contestaste.consejo: Past tense of «contestar», for «tú». The stress is on «TAS».
p.contesté.consejo: Past tense of «contestar», for «yo». The accent mark on the last «é» shows the stress.
p.hablaba.consejo: Imperfect of «hablar», for «él» or «ella». Used in reported questions.
p.columna.consejo: The «c» before «o» is hard, like «k». Stress on «LUM».
p.altavoz.consejo: From «alto» and «voz». The final «z» sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.anuncia.consejo: From «anunciar», to announce. «cia» is pronounced «thya» in Spain.
p.cantaba.consejo: Imperfect of «cantar». It describes something that kept happening in the past.
p.preguntó.consejo: Past tense of «preguntar», for «él» or «ella». The accent marks the stress.
p.siendo.consejo: Gerund of «ser». It means «being», as in English.
